target_customer: Marketing, sales and startup teams (later mid-market and enterprise) buying on-demand presentation and creative design
problem: Teams needed polished slide decks and on-brand design quickly without hiring an agency; SketchDeck delivered designs in about a day.
business_model: Subscription creative services using freelance designers paid hourly plus proprietary project software

founders.name: David Mack
founders.background_notes: YC bio: builds ML models. Designed the original logo per company blog.

competitors.name: Slide design outsourcers
competitors.what: Low cost overseas or freelance slide design services

competitors.name: Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Docs, Apple Keynote

technical_complexity.rationale: Began as a computer-vision iPad app, then became a workflow platform coordinating freelance designers; modest engineering for a service.

defensibility.rationale: Brand templates and dedicated teams gave some stickiness, but design services are easy to copy and rely on labor.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it. A recruiting firm, 24 Seven, bought it in March 2023.

market_need_then: The founders' YC application named low-cost slide design outsourcers as the closest alternative, and TechCrunch March 2014 covered the one-day turnaround of decks.

identity.logo: Original logo by CTO David Mack, later replaced by an in-house design after exploring 45 concepts
identity.visual_style: Original colors borrowed from the founders' previous venture; new identity aimed at friendlier, design-plus-technology feel

rebrands.why: Original brand, built about three years earlier, no longer fit the company; date not stated in the source.

branding.community_and_virality: Built the new brand with its own designer community; no outside community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Steady B2B reputation and its own design work, but evidence is mostly company-authored.

pivots.why: Founders say they pivoted to offering design on demand; exact reason not opened.

outcome_analysis: SketchDeck pivoted from an iPad app to on-demand design, raised about 2.2 million in seed funding by December 2015, and operated for years as a design studio. It was bought by recruiting firm 24 Seven in March 2023 with no price disclosed, a modest outcome for a venture-backed company but a durable service business.
notes: The 500K round is stated by TechCrunch as raised 10 months before December 2015, so I dated it 2015-02; investors for it are not stated. CB Insights labels the December 2015 round Series A while TechCrunch and Seedtable say seed; I used seed. Competitors come from search summary of the founders' archived YC application, not opened directly. Founding year conflicts: YC 2014, PitchBook and CB Insights 2013. Other founder background not found.
